data: How many dots are there before 30% of all annotated data?

The learning curve shows the F1 score for different percentages of training data used in 10-fold cross-validation. The x-axis represents the percentage of all annotated data used in training, ranging from 10% to 90%. The y-axis represents the performance metric, which is the F1 score. The curve starts at approximately 0.4 when 10% of the data is used and increases gradually until it reaches around 0.6 when 90% of the data is used. The question asks how many dots are present on the curve before reaching 30% of the data. From the figure, we can see that there are three dots before the curve reaches 30% of the data.
